• About our brand and products:Wyoming Traders is a western wear company based in Wyoming, offering authentic, high-quality western apparel for men and women — including shirts, vests, outerwear, and accessories. 

• What makes us different: We're the real deal — not a mass-market western brand chasing trends. Our products are built with quality materials, true-to-life western styling, and the kind of craftsmanship that lasts. We're a smaller, independent brand which means every sale matters and every customer gets genuine care.

• How affiliates can earn: Earn 10% commission on every sale made through your unique tracking link. Cookies are tracked for 30 days, so you get credit even if your followers don't buy right away. Payouts are processed on the first of the month following the end of the return window. 

• How to promote us: Share your unique link on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or your blog. Post authentic content wearing or showcasing our products. Lifestyle content performs best — think ranch life, rodeos, outdoor adventures, and everyday western wear. Always disclose your affiliate relationship per FTC guidelines.
payout_period: First of the month following the end of the return window.

WYOMING TRADERS AFFILIATE PROGRAM — TERMS AND CONDITIONS


1. AGREEMENT

By participating in the Wyoming Traders Affiliate Program (the "Program"), you ("Affiliate") agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Wyoming Traders reserves the right to modify these terms at any time, with notice provided via email.


2. PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY

Affiliates must be 18 years of age or older. Wyoming Traders reserves the right to approve or deny any affiliate application at its sole discretion. Participation in the Program does not create an employment, partnership, or agency relationship.


3. COMMISSIONS

Affiliates earn a 10% commission on the net sale price (excluding shipping and taxes) of qualifying purchases made through their unique affiliate tracking link. Commissions are tracked with a 30-day cookie window from the date of the initial click. Commissions on returned or canceled orders will be reversed.


4. PAYMENTS

Commissions are paid on the first Friday following the close of Wyoming Traders' 60-day return policy window, no later. For example, a sale made on January 1 becomes eligible for payment on the first Friday on or after March 2 — ensuring that all return windows have fully closed before any commission is disbursed. There is no minimum payout threshold. Payments will be issued via the method selected during registration. Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information. Wyoming Traders is not responsible for payments lost due to incorrect or outdated information provided by the Affiliate.


5. TAXES

Affiliates are solely responsible for reporting and paying all applicable taxes on commissions earned. A completed W-9 form must be submitted prior to receiving any payments. Affiliates earning $600 or more in a calendar year will receive a 1099 form as required by U.S. law.


6. PROMOTIONAL GUIDELINES

Affiliates must only use approved Wyoming Traders logos, images, and brand assets provided in the Welcome Kit. Affiliates may not alter, modify, or misrepresent Wyoming Traders products, pricing, or brand in any way. Affiliates may not make false or misleading claims about Wyoming Traders products. Affiliates may not offer unauthorized discounts, coupons, or promotions.


7. FTC DISCLOSURE

Affiliates must clearly disclose their affiliate relationship with Wyoming Traders in all promotional content, in compliance with Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines. Acceptable disclosures include language such as "#ad," "#sponsored," or "I earn a commission on purchases made through my link." Failure to disclose may result in immediate termination from the Program.


8. PROHIBITED CONDUCT

Affiliates may not engage in spam, unsolicited email, or any deceptive marketing practices. Affiliates may not bid on Wyoming Traders branded keywords in paid search advertising. Affiliates may not self-refer or generate fraudulent transactions. Any violation of these terms may result in immediate termination and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.


9. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate participation in the Program at any time with written notice. Wyoming Traders reserves the right to terminate any Affiliate immediately for violation of these terms. Upon termination, any earned commissions will be paid on the first Friday following the close of the applicable 60-day return window, provided no fraudulent activity has been identified.


10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Wyoming Traders shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Program. The Program is provided "as is," and Wyoming Traders makes no guarantees regarding earning potential.


11. GOVERNING LAW

These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Wyoming, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
